title: antennaria campestris var. athabascensis
intro: Antennaria campestris var. athabascensis, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting or Athabasca Mountain Everlasting, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its small, white flowers and a rosette-like growth habit. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria campestris var. athabascensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
